scripts.ncu:minor: ncu -t minor -u && pnpm -r exec ncu -t minor -u
scripts.ncu:patch: ncu -t patch -u && pnpm -r exec ncu -t patch -u
scripts.prepare: rimraf .husky && husky install && husky add .husky/commit-msg "npx commitlint --edit $1" && husky add .husky/pre-commit "pnpm -r lint" && husky add .husky/pre-commit "pnpm -r format" && husky add .husky/pre-commit "pnpm ts-prune"
scripts.update: pnpm ncu:patch && pnpm ncu:minor && pnpm ncu:major
